name: 54501 · Rhinelander, WI
findings: ZIP 54501 (Rhinelander) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54501 (Rhinelander) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 54501 (Rhinelander) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
